d:
Last time, Akari had been corrupted by the Numata slime. After waking up, Akari finds her body above the school. When Numata begins to use her and her friends' powers to corrupt the entire school, a new power awakens within her. But will it be enough to save her friends?

It's been a while since I've uploaded. I've started a full-time job since my last upload. That and life got really insane for a while. So I won't be doing many free uploads (unless this series gets a next part or if something REALLY catches my eye). I'll still do commissions, but they'll be slower than before due to my free time being less than before (so I won't charge until AFTER I've finished).

If you have something you'd like me to work on, send me an e-mail at thefrogmanscans@gmail.com
